message.content: In the conversation dated 20261218_18:00, ChaeSong-hwa shares an article with LiHua about how human beings form short-term and long-term memories. LiHua expresses his shock at the intricacy of the brain processes described in the article and discusses how emotions and context can influence our memories. ChaeSong-hwa emphasizes the importance of understanding memory and how it can be beneficial in various fields such as therapy and education. LiHua agrees, stating that grasping the concept of memory can significantly aid in improving therapeutic and educational outcomes.
